title: Odoo 19.0 to 20.0 migration investigation
important_note: Every rule/check in this file is mandatory to investigate for the 16→20 migration path. User-reported change descriptions are leads; verify against exact source tags, official docs, edition and owning model before calling a breaking change confirmed or applying a fix.
required_process: Inspect the source-version implementation (19.0) and target-version implementation (20.0) for each finding.
Check official upgrade/migration notes for the transition.
Trace affected references in Python, XML, CSV, manifest, JS, tests and dependencies.
Classify as confirmed incompatibility, likely issue, false positive, or needs investigation.
Propose a minimal fix and describe behavior/security/data risk.
Wait for explicit approval before editing.
transition_focus: Security model and access-control file structure
API and field removals/renames introduced in this transition
view syntax, stock references and frontend changes
UOM field/model semantics and selection_add ondelete behavior

required_checks.title: Verify target security model and ACL CSV format
verification_steps: Inspect Odoo 19 security definitions and Odoo 20 target source.
Verify whether access-control model/file/columns changed in the exact distribution.
Map ACL permissions and record-rule domains semantically; do not perform filename-only renames.
Validate XML IDs, manifest entries, group implications and effective access behavior.

required_checks.title: Verify UOM models and fields per owning model
Verify selection_add ondelete requirements and lifecycle
Verify stock availability fields and stock view external IDs
Verify all Python, controller, frontend, manifest and report API changes
Only mark a rule as a confirmed 19-to-20 incompatibility when exact target evidence is recorded
Mandatory user-identified migration notes for this transition
verification_steps: Inspect every referenced rule even if the simple scanner did not match a token.
For each applicable rule, record applicable/not applicable/false positive/needs investigation and cite exact target source evidence.
Do not apply edits until the user explicitly approves the proposed patch.
